rationale.conceptual: Implementing a specific Morse-type stretching and cubic angle bending potential from literature, setting up a graphene lattice, and applying hydrostatic boundary forces requires understanding of interatomic potentials and MD methods. It is an established but non-trivial method, not a simple textbook operation.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has two distinct, dependent stages: running a custom MD simulation to generate a force-strain curve, then extracting moduli. While the steps are not extremely long, implementing a custom potential in an MD engine (or coding from scratch) and achieving equilibrium for each force value is a non-trivial engineering task.
